fix(docs-site): stop the picker repeating the hero install command

The hero already shows the command. The picker used to print it again.

The homepage renders SITE.installCommand above the fold, and the host picker below it defaults to Claude Code, whose command is byte-identical. The reader saw the same string twice with only "Paste in a terminal." between them. Now, when the selected host's command matches the hero's, the picker prints Same command as above. instead of a second copy block; the /ork:setup follow-up stays because it is genuinely extra.

The match is a string comparison against SITE.installCommand, not a hardcoded host id: a copy change on either side ends the match on its own, and any host that adopts the same command inherits the rule.

Interactive: the homepage flow

render:

The hero command stays on screen above the fold. Pick hosts and watch what the picker prints under it.

Install in 30 seconds

What to check

With after selected, Claude Code shows "Same command as above." plus the real /ork:setup follow-up, while every other host renders its own command. Flip to before and Claude Code prints the identical block a second time, which is the bug this PR removes.

Data mirrors docs/site/lib/host-installs.ts and SITE.installCommand; the comparison is the same string join the component performs.
